state.title: Universal Recursive Dynamics: Reader's Guide to the Foundational Pair and Companion Technical Note
state.description: This guide accompanies the three-document Universal Recursive Dynamics deposit comprising Paper A (Originary Structural Conditions), Paper B (Above-Threshold Operational Architecture), and the Companion Technical Note (Part III's Mathematical Apparatus and the Operational Architecture of Register). It orients first-time readers, names the interpretive disciplines that govern the documents (breadth/priority, structural-realization-not-tier, inference-available-not-asserted, capacity-as-implicit/instantiation-as-undecidable, and frontier-over-conundrum), summarizes each document's structure and arc, and recommends reading orders for readers approaching from different interests: foundational ontology, AI, cascade-level questions, and formalization. The guide does not substitute for the documents themselves; it is intended to make the deposit set navigable.
